title: Atlas of Hegemony, made simple
metaDesc: How the most powerful country in the world changed from 1492 to 2010, told simply in 11 maps.
subtitle: Hegemony is power great enough to lead or push around other countries. Who held it from 1492 to 2010?

ui.hint: Tap a colored area or a country name.
ui.othersLong: Countries and regions that are not main players in this chapter.

footHtml: Border data: historical-basemaps (to 1880, GPL-3.0) and CShapes 2.0 (from 1914, GPL ≥ 2). Older borders are rough. The text is a short version of the full version.
